<Heading

  children={"Send an email verification"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}/email-verifications"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Emails the credential's address a link confirming it belongs to them.

The credential must already have an `Email`. Verification matters for credentials that use the
web portal — it is how someone recovers their own password without you being involved. A
machine-to-machine credential with no address does not need it.

`EmailVerified` flips to `true` only when the recipient follows the link; there is no way to set
it directly.

Calling this again sends a fresh link, so it also serves as a resend — but repeat sends to the
same address are rate limited, and an immediate retry returns `429`. Wait a few minutes.

It works whether or not the address is already verified.
